features.description: Authenticates every request with the team API key in `Authorization: Api-Key <key>`, plus any extra client headers; constructing a client with an empty `api_key` or an `authorization` header raises ValidationError before any request.
Sends requests to `<base_url>/api/v0/events/` and the other resource paths under it, keeping any path prefix the base URL carries.
Applies `timeout_ms` per attempt; exceeding it raises TransportError.
A connection that cannot be established (refused, DNS, TLS) raises TransportError with no status.
Sends exactly the supplied envelope members — resolved trail, snake_case keys, absent or null members omitted, `created_at` verbatim, and the envelope's idempotency_key winning over the client's.
Generates a lowercase UUIDv4 idempotency_key for an emit that does not supply one, and reuses it across retries of that emit.
201 answers EmitResult with `duplicate` false and the stored AuditEvent; 200 answers `duplicate` true; any other 2xx raises ApiError; every synchronous emit answers `queued` false.

Rejects an empty `event` and an unresolved (empty or absent) trail with ValidationError before any request, and nothing else: values the server validates, such as empty metadata values or names past 255 characters, are forwarded unchanged.
Posts `{"events": [envelope…]}` with one generated idempotency key per item lacking one; an empty list or an item whose resolved trail is missing raises ValidationError naming the failing item.
202 or 207 answers BatchResult with accepted/rejected counts and per-item results; a rejected item carries the server's error code, message and field.
Sends only the supplied filters, in spec order, with values encoded by the generated core; the client's default trail is not applied to reads.
200 answers EventPage with the results and the next cursor decoded from the `next` URL's `cursor` parameter, null when `next` is absent or has none.
Follows next cursors page by page, yielding events lazily; an error on a later page is raised after the earlier events were yielded.
Maps every non-2xx response (and undecodable success bodies) onto the error kinds with `status`, `code`, `field` and `retry_after`.

Retries transport failures, 500/502/503/504 and 429 (unless the code is `quota_exceeded`) up to `max_retries` times with the same body and keys, honouring `Retry-After` unless it exceeds `max_backoff_ms`.

With an `outbox`, `emit` validates as usual, stores the resolved envelope and answers EmitResult `queued` true with its idempotency key and no event, without making a request; a full memory outbox raises OutboxError `outbox_full`; `close` flushes what is pending.
A queued emit rejects an empty `event` and an unresolved trail with ValidationError before anything is stored.
A pass sends the outbox in FIFO batches of at most `batch_size` envelopes per request, keys unchanged.

`pre_send` sees each stored event before its request and may modify or drop it; a raising `pre_send` leaves the event in the outbox and reports a `failed` outcome with OutboxError `hook_failed`; `post_send` receives the original event and its outcome and its exceptions are ignored.

A 202/207 answers one `post_send` outcome per sent event: accepted/duplicate with the id, rejected with a ValidationError (a SchemaValidationError for the code `schema_validation_failed`) carrying the item's code and field and the response status.

Each batch is sent once, without the client's retries; a batch whose request fails with TransportError, ServerError or RateLimitedError is released for a later pass and the pass ends; any other failure drops the batch; both report `failed` outcomes.
Forwards an integer `schema_version` pin unchanged on emit, on each batch item and in the stored outbox event; omitted when absent, never validated locally.

A 400, 413 or 422 whose code is `schema_validation_failed` raises SchemaValidationError; other validation codes stay ValidationError; a rejected outbox item with that code reports SchemaValidationError.

get/create/update/delete an event definition on its exact path with only the supplied members (`new_action` sent as `action`); 200/201 answer the EventDefinition, 204 answers nothing, any other 2xx raises ApiError.

get/create/update/delete/publish/deprecate a schema version on its exact path with `{"schema": …}` bodies, `If-Match` only when given, and the response `ETag` returned verbatim beside the EventSchemaVersion.
Lists and iterates definitions and versions with `cursor`/`limit` in spec order and the next cursor decoded from `next`.
Dry-runs a document and answers the SchemaCheck.
Lists the standard catalog and installs packs, forwarding slugs unchanged for the server to judge.
An empty `action` raises ValidationError field `action` before any request.
Schema operations retry like events, except `create_version`, which is sent once.
